messages:
Tanya Brooks: Quick heads-up  Meridian Health onboarding flagged a vendor security appendix in their PO that asks for: SOC2 attestation link, list of subprocessors, CMK support, audit-log retention options, and whether we can provide field-level tokenization for patient identifiers. They said PO will hold until we return answers. Deadline: Thu EOD.

Elena Morales: I can assemble the subprocessors list and region placement line. Ravi, can you draft short product-safe bullets for CMK & tokenization? Keep it procurement-friendly.

Ravi Singh: Yep. Product-approved bullets: 
- CMK: Hosted default uses provider-managed KMS. Dedicated/Private support customer-managed keys (CMK) and HSM; Hosted CMK available via enterprise contract.
- Tokenization: We provide application-level tokenization patterns and token vaulting. For strict field-level PHI tokenization we recommend Private deployment with customer HSM + tokenization proxy.

Priya Nair: Legal: we will sign Redwood's standard DPA for enterprise deals. We can review customer DPA but require legal approval; avoid promising bespoke transfer mechanisms without escalation. SOC2/pen-test artifacts should be delivered under NDA only.

Elena Morales: Subprocessors (high level): cloud compute, object storage, DB-as-a-service, CDN, monitoring/metrics, identity provider. Will attach CSV via secure link once NDA is in place.

Tanya Brooks: Great. Can someone paste a single reply that checks all boxes? Also flag renewal/PO risk if provisioning stalls >7 days.

Ravi Singh: Draft to paste: 
"Thanks0200 Meridian team. Answers below:
- SOC2: Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II; redacted attestation and supporting artifacts available under NDA.
- Subprocessors: summary attached; full list via secure link after NDA.
- Encryption: Data encrypted at rest with AES-256; TLS 1.3 in transit. Hosted uses provider KMS; Dedicated/Private support CMK/HSM. Hosted CMK available under enterprise contract.
- Audit logs: Hosted retention 90 days by default; Dedicated/Private configurable up to 12 months (enterprise add-on). Redacted sample events available under NDA.
- Tokenization: application-level tokenization available; for strict field-level PHI tokenization recommend Private deployment with customer HSM and tokenization proxy.
If youd like artifacts, please sign the NDA and well upload the SOC2 attestation and pen-test summary. Note: if PO provisioning is delayed more than 7 days please notify your AE for escalation."

Priya Nair: That wording looks good. Don't promise >12 months Hosted log retention. Also add a line that deletion/export workflows can be provided as an enterprise feature.

Tanya Brooks: Perfect. Elena, can you send and create a task to track PO risk?

OnboardBot: Task created: "Send Meridian security answers & track PO risk" assigned to Elena Morales, due 2026-06-12.

Elena Morales: Sent reply at 2001113450 with draft above and NDA link. I flagged the PO risk and asked them to indicate preferred region for residency.

Tanya Brooks: Thanks everyone 44d. Paste Meridians reply here when they respond so we can triage any follow-ups quickly.
